letters.text: I keep counting the years I wasted. Everyone my age seems to be somewhere, and I am still at the start. Is it too late for someone like me?
My father and I have not spoken in two years. I tell myself I don't care. Then his birthday comes and I sit with the phone in my hand.
I have everything I said I wanted. A good job, a nice flat. So why does it all feel so empty when the lights go off?
People at work think I am confident. Inside I am terrified they will find out I don't really know what I am doing.
I lost someone this winter. People tell me it gets easier. It doesn't feel like it will. How do you carry something this heavy?
I always notice what others do wrong. Lately I wonder if I am the one people are tired of.
